R-21: Compare watches and learn more about the ultra version on fakeapple.com.
Goal: Compare watches and learn more about the ultra version on fakeapple.com.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-21/
STEP 2: Hover over "Watch"
STEP 3: Click "Compare watches"
STEP 4: Select "Watch Ultra" in the "Model 3" menu
STEP 5: Click "Learn more" under "Watch Ultra"
STEP 6: Verify "Compared watches and opened: Watch Ultra overview" is visible

plan.title: Compare watches and open Watch Ultra overview

steps.note: Select Watch Ultra and confirm the menu shows it.
Open the overview for Watch Ultra.
